service.description: The current user's permission on a contact book: CbpManage for the owner of a personal book (a personal book has no shares), else the highest current ContactBookShare for the user or one of the user's groups. With permissionEnumId, an error when the user has less; a book the user has no permission on is "not found".

parameter.name: permissionEnumId
parameter.description: The permission needed: CbpView, CbpEdit or CbpManage. Empty only reports.

parameter.name: contactBook
parameter.description: Null when the user has no permission

service.description: A personal book (the default) belongs to the current user; the user's first personal book is the default one, and isDefault=Y makes this one the default. A shared book may belong to an organization (ownerPartyId), and its creator gets a manage share.

parameter.name: ownerPartyId
parameter.description: For a shared book, the organization it belongs to

parameter.name: contactBookShareId
parameter.description: The creator's manage share of a shared book

service.description: Needs manage permission. A field left out (null) is not changed. isDefault=Y makes a personal book the user's default; the default stays until another book is made the default.

Needs manage permission. Removes the book with its members, groups and shares. A personal contact that would be in none of its owner's books after this moves to the owner's default book; the default book itself is not deleted (make another book the default first).

parameter.name: movedPartyIdList
parameter.description: Personal contacts moved to the default book

service.description: The current user's default personal book, created on first use; when the user has personal books but none is the default, the oldest becomes it.

Needs manage permission; a shared book only. Opens the book to a user or a user group; when that user or group already has a current share, its permission (and thruDate) change instead. The last manage share cannot be lowered.
Needs manage permission. Ends (thruDate now) the current shares named by contactBookShareId, userId or userGroupId; the last manage share is not ended.

Needs edit permission. Adds parties to a book (and to groups of that book), skipping those already in it. Each party must be one the user may see; a personal contact goes only in its owner's personal books. A party that cannot be added is skipped and listed in failedPartyIdList with a warning, and the rest are added.

parameter.name: isFavorite
parameter.description: Y or N to set on each, when given

service.description: Needs edit permission. Ends (thruDate now) the parties' current membership of the book and removes them from its groups. A personal contact stays its owner's (find#Party with personalContacts=only finds it).
Needs edit permission. A group with the same name (ignoring case) in the book is returned instead of a new one.
Needs edit permission on the group's book. A field left out (null) is not changed.
Needs edit permission on the group's book. The parties stay in the book.
Needs edit permission on the group's book. A party not yet in the book is added to it, as add#ContactBookParties does (and skipped the same way).
Needs edit permission on the group's book. The parties stay in the book.
Stars (isFavorite=Y) or unstars a party in a book, the user's default book when contactBookId is empty. Needs edit permission; starring a party not in the book adds it.

Needs view permission. The book's current members the user may see, by name, organization, email or phone (text), group and favorite, a page at a time: the names, the organization and title (a person's current PrtContact or PrtEmployee relationship), the primary email (EmailPrimary first) and phone (PhonePrimary, then PhoneMobile, first), the groups of this book, isFavorite and isPersonal.

The current user's personal books (the default first) and the shared books shared with the user or the user's groups, each with the user's permission, its current member count (the members the user may see), and its groups with their counts.

Creates a party from a contact map, or with partyId adds to one (fills empty fields when updateData, and adds the emails, phones, addresses and websites it does not have). Used by create#PersonalContact and mantle.party.ContactImportServices; access to the party is the caller's to check. The contact map: partyTypeEnumId (PtyPerson, the default, or PtyOrganization), firstName, middleName, lastName, personalTitle, suffix, nickname, birthDate (yyyy-MM-dd), comments, organizationName (an organization's name, or for a person the organization found by name among those the user may see, or created, linked by a PrtContact relationship), organizationPartyId (for a person), jobTitle (the relationship's name), and the lists emails [{emailAddress, contactMechPurposeId}], phones [{countryCode, areaCode, contactNumber, contactMechPurposeId}], addresses [{address1, address2, unitNumber, city, stateProvinceGeoId, postalCode, countryGeoId, contactMechPurposeId}] and websites [{webAddress, contactMechPurposeId}].

parameter.name: partyId
parameter.description: An existing party to add to; empty creates one

parameter.name: privateOwnerUserId
parameter.description: For a new personal contact, its owner (the current user)

parameter.name: roleTypeId
parameter.description: For a new directory party, its role

parameter.name: updateData
parameter.description: For an existing party: fill its empty fields and add the contact mechanisms it lacks. False changes nothing.

service.description: A person (the default) or an organization seen only by the current user (Party.privateOwnerUserId), with an email, phone and address, in one of the user's personal books (the default book when contactBookId is empty) and its groups. A person needs a first or last name; organizationPartyId and jobTitle link the person to an organization (PrtContact).

Makes one of the current user's personal contacts a directory party: with targetPartyId it is merged into that directory party (mantle.party.DuplicateServices.merge#Parties, which moves its book memberships and the rest), else its privateOwnerUserId is cleared, with roleTypeId added when given.
